presentation.label: FOOT SWITCH
presentation.summary: A footswitch or gate on EXP/CV IN 1 or 2 holds or toggles the MUTE screen, or switches live recording.
presentation.overview: Stock's CONTROL INPUT menus get a fourth MODE, FSW. Pick what the pedal does in FOOTSW DEST: MUTE HOLD shows the MUTE screen while the pedal is down and goes back to the mode you were in when you let go, MUTE TOGGLE opens and closes it, LIVE REC turns live recording on and off. FOOTSWITCH LEARN reads your pedal's two levels; a 0 to 5 V gate works without it. Each jack has its own MODE, so one can switch while the other still plays the kit's CV or expression macro.
highlights: Hands-free mutes with both hands on the pads
Set up in stock's own CONTROL INPUT menus, saved with them
Works with a footswitch or a 0 to 5 V gate
usage: Hold the pedal, punch mutes on the pads, release to go back to playing.
Tap the pedal to drop into live recording and again to leave it while the pattern plays on.

steps: Connect the footswitch or gate to EXP/CV IN 1 or 2.
Open GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 (or 2) and set MODE to FSW.
Set FOOTSW DEST to MUTE HOLD, MUTE TOGGLE or LIVE REC.
For a footswitch, run FOOTSWITCH LEARN and press it a few times; if pressing does the opposite, set REVERSE DIRECTION.

limitations: Stay within the jack's -5 V to +5 V.
The pedal is read about 20 times a second, so an action can come up to about 50 ms after it.
A jack in FSW mode plays no CONTROL IN MOD macro. Without the module, a unit left in FSW mode reads that jack as nothing.

claims: ui:GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 and 2: MODE FSW and the FOOTSW DEST list
input:EXP/CV IN 1 and 2 in FSW mode

load.conditions: UI only: two readings each UI tick, never in the audio path.
